description: Land Title Settlement Department - Senarathgama, Harispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District  and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications). The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and contains detailed schedules with land ownership information, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
